_comment: The shipped rule: small vugs through the whole rock column.
The band spans the world rather than a tuned slice, because a carving may be paired with any terrain
and a fixed band would quietly do nothing for half of them. The carve loop skips air first (OpenGround),
scale is blocks per unit of noise — how big a pocket is. Small on purpose: raise it and the pockets
grow, meet one another and become caves, which is a different preset's job. threshold is the single
dial worth turning: the noise is near-normal, so a high one takes only the extremes and leaves rock
